reason: The hypothesis proposes applying an aluminizing treatment to the specific RHEA HfNbTaTiZr to form a protective Al2O3 scale, an intervention not studied in any passage. While the mechanism of Al2O3 barrier formation is general knowledge, and the base alloy and its mechanical properties are well-documented, no passage combines aluminizing with this alloy or predicts the preservation of its room-temperature ductility and high-temperature strength after such a treatment. The idea transfers a known oxidation protection strategy to a new alloy system with a reasoned expectation of mechanical property retention, which is a non-trivial extension beyond the existing literature.
